headline_marked: Curl project announces [[July 2026 vulnerability report pause]] for 'summer of bliss'
headline: Curl project announces July 2026 vulnerability report pause for 'summer of bliss'
summary: The popular command-line tool will not accept or handle any security reports for the entire month of July 2026, pushing back its 8.22.0 release by two weeks.
details: The curl project is implementing a 'summer of bliss' initiative, during which it will not accept or process any vulnerability reports throughout July 2026. This means both the HackerOne submission form and the dedicated security email address will be inactive for security-related submissions.

Maintainers plan to use this period for rest and personal time, aiming to reduce the immense pressure they've been under. While the submission channels will be closed, the project's issue and pull-request trackers on GitHub will remain open and active as usual.

As a direct consequence of this planned break, the release of curl version 8.22.0 has been postponed by two weeks, now scheduled for September 2, 2026. This allows the team extra time to address any issues that may have accumulated.

The project encourages other open-source initiatives to adopt similar 'summer of bliss' periods to prioritize self-care. However, it's important to note that users with paid support contracts will continue to receive full service without interruption during this time.

headline_marked: [[Claude AI now integrates with Apple platforms]] via Foundation Models framework
headline: Claude AI now integrates with Apple platforms via Foundation Models framework
summary: Developers can now easily bring Claude's advanced AI capabilities into their Apple applications using the new Claude for Foundation Models Swift package. This simplifies AI integration for iOS, macOS, and other Apple OSes.
details: Anthropic's Claude AI is now accessible on Apple platforms through the Foundation Models framework. This integration allows developers to leverage Claude's advanced capabilities directly within their Apple applications.

The key enabler is the new Claude for Foundation Models Swift package. This package provides a streamlined way for Swift developers to incorporate Claude into their iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS projects.

This move significantly simplifies the process of building AI-powered features for Apple devices. Developers can now focus on creating innovative user experiences rather than complex backend integrations.

The Foundation Models framework itself is designed to provide a unified interface for various large language models. This allows for greater flexibility and future-proofing for developers working with AI on Apple's ecosystem.
